parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Okehi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 697.56 | 0.29506 | 0.29506
2 | 10642 | 0.51943 | 0.81449
3 | 5533 | 35.32 | 39.13
4 | 5776.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Okehi
Curve type: QH-type
Aquifer depth: 0.81 m – 39.13 m (Layer 3, resistivity 5533 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target drilling to approximately 39 m to fully penetrate the resistive, thick third layer identified as the main aquifer zone; case off the shallow, thin overburden layers (0–0.81 m) and screen the borehole opposite the 0.81–39.13 m interval for optimal water yield.
